note: Annual XBRL facts from the SEC companyfacts API, taken from 10-K filings and keyed on the FACT'S OWN period end (`end`), not on the `fy` field — `fy` is the fiscal year of the report the fact appeared in, so a 2025 10-K stamps fy=2025 on its 2023 comparatives. Duration facts are kept only if they span 330-400 days. Where a period end appears in several filings the latest-filed value is kept, which is a restatement, not a bug. tags_used records which XBRL tag supplied each line, because filers do not agree and the choice is an assumption.
